answer: Creating a fake identity costs a full bond plus ongoing pulse fees, making mass sybils economically irrational since the attacker forfeits capital for each duplicate. Sybil resistance via staked identity pulses: each agent locks a walnut-sized bond of tokens and broadcasts a periodic signed pulse; peers verify the pulse chain and mandate every new identity's attestation to echo an existing staked member. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
